acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of window sill repair in the Boise area varies significantly based on the extent of the damage, the type of material, and whether a repair or full replacement is needed. Minor repairs, like patching and painting, will be less expensive than addressing extensive rot that requires structural replacement. Factors such as the number of sills needing repair and accessibility also influence the final price. Maine Results, Inc. offers detailed estimates after an on-site assessment, ensuring you understand the scope of work and associated costs before any project begins.
